claim: SPS Commerce’s 2025 Form 10-K describes the company as one of the largest providers of cloud-based supply-chain management services and says recurring-revenue customers use its network to expand and optimize trading relationships.

claim: External March 2026 research described SPS Commerce as a supply-chain network connecting about 120,000 trading partners, with 95% recurring revenue, major US retailer connectivity, and a stock down 60% from its high.

claim: The same March 2026 external research item stated that management guidance called for 6-7% revenue growth versus a historical 18-20% range, attributing the slowdown to macro uncertainty and tariff volatility delaying discretionary supplier technology spending.
